purpose: Durable image-production source authority for Rex Fleet covers. Keeps cover trade dress stable while allowing each issue to have a distinct selling image.

recipeAuthority.rule: The assembled current-issue cover recipe controls the selling concept, focal hierarchy, cast, environment, composition, thumbnail read, spoiler ceiling and issue-specific visual emphasis.

productionGate: Assemble the exact current cover recipe from RexPrompt.
Retrieve the canonical Issue 1 cover as actual image pixels and inspect it before generation.
Select any additional released/current-production character, ship, location or faction references required by the recipe.
Apply the Issue 1 cover only to trade dress and brand continuity; do not copy its montage composition into later issues.
Generate from the assembled cover recipe plus the selected pixel references.
Audit thumbnail read, exact trade-dress lettering, character/world continuity, spoiler ceiling and absence of invented environmental text before approval.
issue1Rule: Issue 1 is released canon. Do not regenerate or replace its cover unless explicitly reopened by the user.
